newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates in 7.00-8.25 pct range.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates in 7.00-8.25 pct range.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar fell to 7.00-8.25 percent on Tuesday from 8.25-8.50 percent on Monday with injection of more dinar funds, idealers said.
"There is not much demand in the market with more supply that is easing a tight market," one dealer said.
Dealers said the market began tight but at end of clearing an oversurplus of funds sent rates futher down with extra liquidity emerging within the banking sector.
